g.text: Row hover = light fill. Whole row is the click target (opens Trip detail).

svg.text: ANNOTATIONS
View-as switch
Rider or Ops manager. There is no login: this
switch is the demo actor picker. In Rider mode
a searchable picker chooses one of the 1,000
riders.
Filters are query parameters
Search, status and date range map to GET
/api/trips?search=&status=&from=&to=. Typing
is debounced (300 ms). The URL keeps the
filters, so back and refresh work.
Server-side paging
25 rows per page (max 100). The browser never
receives all 50,000 trips; the total comes
from COUNT(*). Default sort: newest first.
Status badges
One badge style per trip status, always with
its text label so colour is never the only
cue. Colours are in the style guide.
Row opens detail
Trip detail shows the status stepper, rider,
vehicle and review. Ops can advance the status
there (PATCH /api/trips/:id/status).
Data source health
The sidebar footer polls GET /api/health. A
store that is down greys its dot, and only the
cards that use it show an error (see W09).
